attributes.board_name: Delaware Examining Board of Physical Therapists and Athletic Trainers (Division of Professional Regulation)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved CE (Board list of approved courses; licensees and providers may request course approval through DELPROS).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Prorated at the first renewal by issue date: issued 2/1 odd year - before 8/1 odd year 2.5 CEU; 8/1 odd - before 2/1 even 2.0 CEU; 2/1 even - before 8/1 even 1.5 CEU; 8/1 even - before 10/1 even 0.5 CEU; on or after 10/1 even year 3.0 CEU.
rules.audit_note: CE is entered in the DELPROS CE Tracker and attested at renewal; do not upload documents unless audited. Random audit after renewal: within 20 days upload current CPR card and certificates of completion, including proof of 0.2 CEU ethics.

topics.who: 0.2 CEU (two hours) of ethics, within the 3.0 CEUs
CPR course; counts as 0.1 CEU; current CPR card required on audit

rules.legal_basis: 24 Del. Admin. Code 2600, Section 13.0; 24 Del. C. Ch. 26
rules.notes: 3.0 CEUs = 30 hours (Board: 1 CEU = 10 hours). Licensure period February 1 (odd year) - January 31 (next odd year); licenses expire January 31 of odd years. Same requirement for PTs, PTAs and athletic trainers.
rules.rule_quote: Active Physical Therapist, Physical Therapy Assistants and Athletic Trainers must complete 3.0 units of approved CE during each full licensure renewal period between February 1 and January 31 odd-numbered years (2017-2019, 2019-2021, etc.).
